items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 136:1
items.html: When there are judgments in ZON, that is, whenever they lack GAR, the Klipot can grip in their posterior, that is, in the vessels from the Chazeh [chest] and downward. And to be guarded from them, the correction of back to back is made, so that their backs are inward and their faces are exposed outward, and from the faces they cannot suck. And this correction of the concealment of the posterior is called a covering. Therefore the world of Yetzirah, which is VAK without a head, needs the aspect of this covering. Therefore Assiyah was made in the aspect of three within three, in order to become the aspect of a covering over Yetzirah, so that the externals cannot suck from them. Therefore there are two aspects in the world of Yetzirah: food and covering. Food: they are the Mochin to sustain it. And the covering is the aspect of the covering of the world of Assiyah, which covers it from the externals. But in Assiyah there is only food alone, for it does not need to cover another, since in its very essence it is the covering, as above. (Item 135).
